name: manual_1bff80
claim: Fable-5 Tier-Based Routing: Each tier in frugality_router.py must enforce hard 10s timeout via killable background call (run_in_background=true, never bundled timeout N && cmd). Enforce fail-closed cost gate (Tier2+: gate() raises on deny, no silent reroute). Validate worst-case bounded latency <=40s (4 tiers) vs interactive SLA. Consensus: 7/7 subagent types. This prevents silent cost-gate bypasses (LINT-400 100% pass), cascade failures from tier timeouts, and SLA violations.

decisions.notes: Production frugality_router.py v1.1 already implements 7-tier chain but timeouts are ad hoc (1.5s) and unbounded worst-case. Memory entry feedback_no_sleep_chains + feedback_hard_deadlines_no_hang established that timeout N && cmd is blocked; network calls need killable bg jobs. Aligns cost_guard.gate() policy enforcement with per-tier probe timeouts (single TIER_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S=10.0 constant across probe.py, connectivity.py, frugality_router.py).
